body:
[Erowid Note: 
Most Coricidin contains CPM (Chlorpheniramine Maleate) which can be dangerous in high doses. See
DXM Brand Warnings
for more info.]
I stepped foot into the most drug infested area in my city... Winn Dixie. The manager stared at me while I walked to the soda isle. I scanned all the soda down and walked to the cough and cold isle. I looked for the forbidden Coriciden Cough & Cold. I swiped 2 boxes, and bought a cranberry sierra mist. Walked out of the store, and stayed calm until I turned a corner, I then popped 16, 2 at a time. Then did nothing for about 1 hour... Still no effects, I know that it takes about 1-2 hours, but I had been experiencing mild effects from 16 recently. So I took 8 more and walked home. When I got home I decided to play cards with my mom and dad. I was speeding through games, all of a sudden started feeling numb, and very light. Lost in my crazy thoughts, I closed my eyes and was stuck in wild hallucinations. I shuffled to the fridge, my parents looking crazy at me. They started asking me if I was high but I couldnt answer, I muttered 'I'm going to.... Bed.' I stumbled to my room and shut the door, tried to go to sleep, having extreme hallucinations, I was lost in another world. I felt so good. I felt like I took ecstasy or PCP. Then, my parents came in. 'What did you take?' I did a C sign with my hand and went to sleep. Enjoyed my high.
